uncited: - Inputs: volumetric mesh vertices $V$, volumetric mesh faces $F$, surface mesh vertices $V^s$, surface mesh faces $F^s$, weighting coefficients $\lambda_a, \lambda_b, \lambda_c$, Laplacian weights $\alpha, \beta$, orientation threshold $v_0$.
